nodes.label: Remotion CLI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Standard npm and npx remotion commands for installing dependencies, running Studio preview (npm run dev), rendering videos (npx remotion render), and upgrading packages.

nodes.label: Remotion Company License
nodes.rationale: Notes that a company license is required for certain entities using Remotion.

nodes.label: Remotion Video Project
nodes.rationale: Root project README defining standard Remotion installation, Studio preview, video render, upgrade commands, documentation links, and company licensing terms.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Stores god nodes, community structure, and cross-file relationships at graphify-out/ so agents can inspect scoped subgraphs instead of broad raw reads; graph.json is rewritten whole on rebuilds so large PR diffs are expected.

nodes.label: Graphify Query-First Workflow
nodes.rationale: Mandates running graphify query, path, explain, or section before grep or raw source reads to return smaller scoped subgraphs, and running AST-only graphify update . after modifying code.
